title: AppNix Configuration
description: Schema for AppNix config.yml — defines defaults and app entries for building Electron .rpm packages.

defaults.description: Global defaults applied to all app builds.

electron_version.description: Electron version used to build all apps.

lang.description: Default language/locale for the Electron shell.

maintainer.description: Package maintainer in 'Name <email>' format for .rpm metadata.

spellcheck.description: List of locale codes enabled for spellcheck.

apps.description: List of web apps to package as Electron .rpm applications.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the desktop entry.

url.description: URL loaded by the Electron wrapper.

icon.description: Icon filename (without extension) from the icons directory.

app_name.description: Machine identifier used for package name, binary and paths. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

category.description: FreeDesktop.org menu categories separated by semicolons.

description.description: Short description for the desktop entry and package metadata.
examples: Cloud file storage, sync and real-time collaboration

keywords.description: Search keywords for desktop environment discovery.
